name: InputAddon
purpose: Present a noninteractive external segment attached to a native input.
useWhen: A prefix or suffix belongs in a separate segment outside the input boundary.

avoidWhen.condition: Content belongs inside the input boundary.

composition: Compose Group attached with InputAddon and Input. Set matching size and variant explicitly on both; Group does not propagate Input recipes.

rules.statement: Keep InputAddon noninteractive. Use Button or IconButton for actions and Field for labels; meaningful units must be present in accessible descriptions.
Load styles.css or core.css with input-addon.css, input.css and group.css when composing.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using an addon as the only label or as a button.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Field.Label and a real named Button for actions.

validation: Check attached edges, matching heights, RTL, narrow widths and responsive recipes.
